title: An alcohol or an ether
hook: Count the atoms and trace their bonds.

knows: Condensed structural formulas and covalent bonds.
doesNotKnow: Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀O, but their atoms connect differently. 1-butanol and diethyl ether are constitutional isomers.

misconception: Different-looking structural drawings must represent different formulas or different compounds.
objective: Compare molecular formula and connectivity when classifying two structures.

claims.text: Structure A is 1-butanol (C₄H₁₀O); structure B is diethyl ether (C₄H₁₀O). Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀O, but their atoms connect differently. 1-butanol and diethyl ether are constitutional isomers.
Constitutional isomers have the same molecular formula but different atomic connectivity.
The diagrams show condensed connectivity, not stereochemistry or molecular geometry.
Recall: What relationship do 1-butanol and diethyl ether have? Both structures have formula C₄H₁₀O, but their atoms connect differently. 1-butanol and diethyl ether are constitutional isomers.
